players.product: plasma etch tools for 3D NAND and advanced logic (CCP incl. 60:1 ultra-high-aspect-ratio dielectric etch; cryogenic high-aspect-ratio ICP etch) plus tungsten CVD / ALD deposition for 3D NAND word lines

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue about RMB 123.85 hundred million, up about 36.62% year over year; etch equipment sales about RMB 98.32 hundred million (+35.12%) and LPCVD equipment sales about RMB 5.06 hundred million (+224.23%), as new shipments of its high-end tools for critical etch steps in advanced logic and memory rose significantly. Net profit attributable to shareholders about RMB 21.11 hundred million (+30.69%), including about RMB 6.61 hundred million of fair-value and investment gains on equity investments; net profit excluding non-recurring items about RMB 15.50 hundred million (+11.64%), held back by R&D expense of RMB 24.75 hundred million (+74.61%). Gross margin 39.17%, down 1.89 percentage points, because it gave some customers sales discounts amid a structural change in its customer base. Mainland China revenue RMB 12,058,314,866.56 (+40.07%); Taiwan RMB 215,350,813.57 (-31.63%); other countries and regions RMB 110,972,587.98 (-21.59%). Q4 2025 revenue RMB 4,322,073,152.69 and net profit RMB 900,280,589.61.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue RMB 123.85 hundred million (+36.62%); etch sales RMB 98.32 hundred million (+35.12%); LPCVD sales RMB 5.06 hundred million (+224.23%); net profit RMB 21.11 hundred million (+30.69%); gross margin 39.17%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 output and shipments: specialised equipment production 1,660 chambers (+8.07%), sales 1,240 chambers (+27.97%), inventory 1,010 chambers (+36.67%). CCP etch shipped more than 1000 reaction chambers in 2025 alone, and its cumulative installed base passed 5000 chambers (more than 30% average annual compound growth for ten years); the cumulative ICP etch installed base reached 1800 chambers (average growth above 100% a year over nine years); cumulative LPCVD thin-film shipments passed 300 chambers. The company aims in 2026 to shorten equipment delivery cycles and strive to keep 100% on-time order delivery.
quarterly_data.figure: production 1,660 chambers (+8.07%); sales 1,240 chambers (+27.97%); CCP cumulative installed base over 5000 chambers; ICP cumulative 1800 chambers

quarterly_data.signal: Memory etch (2025 annual report): its plasma etch tools are used in volume production of 3D NAND above 200 layers, and its share of new installations for memory etch kept rising in 2025. After volume production of ultra-high-aspect-ratio deep-hole etch in 2024, its PrimoUD-RIE reached large-scale volume production of ultra-high-aspect-ratio trench etch in 2025; lab development of the next-generation tool for more advanced 3D memory ultra-high-aspect-ratio etch is complete (new chamber for highly corrosive gases and ultra-low-temperature etch, much less fluorocarbon gas). Nanova LUX-Cryo passed customer qualification, won repeat orders and is in volume production on the customer's next-generation product line. Its new-generation ICP etch tool for memory: Beta tools passed several ICP etch process qualifications at multiple technology nodes on 3D NAND and DRAM customers' lines, with some processes in high-volume production as baseline tools.

Deposition and other tools (2025 annual report): its contact-hole tungsten CVD tool completed mass-production verification at a leading domestic memory chipmaker and received volume orders; logic and specialty-device customers also completed verification and placed repeat orders. Its ALD TiN tool passed sample verification at several key memory customers. Its reduced-pressure epitaxy (germanium-silicon selective EPI) Beta tool is in mass-production verification at 28nm/22nm mature-node customers and in customer verification for 7nm and below, with some advanced processes in mass-production verification. More than twenty new tools across six equipment categories are under development. Advanced packaging: PrimoTSV300E for 2.5D / 3D packaging through-silicon vias won repeat orders and completed process development for 12-inch high-aspect-ratio deep-trench capacitor etch and SoIC wafer-on-wafer, verified on a leading domestic customer's line; it started developing a CuBS PVD integrated tool for advanced packaging.
quarterly_data.figure: more than twenty new tools under development

quarterly_data.signal: MOCVD (2025 annual report): AMEC says it keeps its lead in GaN-based LED MOCVD equipment. Its Micro-LED MOCVD tool PreciomoUdx met a leading domestic customer's line requirements and won repeat orders; its GaN power-device MOCVD tool PRISMO PD5 passed verification on customer lines and won repeat orders, and a new-generation GaN power MOCVD tool was shipped to a leading customer for production verification; its new 8-inch SiC epitaxy tool is in trial-production verification at leading domestic firms.

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and plan (2025 annual report): R&D investment about RMB 37.44 hundred million in 2025, up 52.65%, 30.23% of revenue (RMB 10.45 hundred million capitalised); 1548 R&D staff, 52.24% of employees. The company says it now develops a competitive new tool in two years or less instead of three to five, and expects to launch new products on a larger scale in the coming years. 2026 plan: segment its etch products for the different etch needs of advanced logic, DRAM and 3D NAND; further develop LPCVD, EPI and ALD products to cover more high-end critical steps; develop a new-generation GaN power MOCVD tool, SiC epitaxy and red / yellow LED MOCVD tools; consider investing in or acquiring domestic and overseas high-end semiconductor equipment and key component makers. It plans to acquire a controlling stake in Hangzhou Zhonggui Electronic Technology (wet processing) to move from dry to dry-plus-wet process solutions.
